requirements.title: E2E test for desktop app generation
requirements.description: End-to-end test that generates a desktop app and validates the complete output

requirements.title: Generated desktop app has correct file structure
requirements.description: Validates that generated desktop apps follow the standard platforms/electron/ structure

requirements.title: Generated desktop app dependencies install successfully
requirements.description: npm install completes successfully in generated desktop app directory

requirements.title: Generated desktop app TypeScript builds successfully
requirements.description: TypeScript compilation completes and produces valid JavaScript in dist/

requirements.title: Native menu integration in templates
requirements.description: Templates include native menu bar with File, Edit, View, Window, Help menus

requirements.title: System tray integration in advanced templates
requirements.description: Advanced/multi-window/kiosk templates include system tray with context menu

requirements.title: Native file dialog integration
requirements.description: Templates include IPC handlers for native file open/save dialogs

requirements.title: System notification support
requirements.description: Templates support system notifications via Electron notification API

requirements.title: Windows platform build support
requirements.description: Desktop apps can be packaged as Windows .msi installers

requirements.title: macOS platform build support
requirements.description: Desktop apps can be packaged as macOS .pkg installers

requirements.title: Linux platform build support
requirements.description: Desktop apps can be packaged as Linux .AppImage or .deb packages

requirements.title: Operator pipeline commands support durable waiting
requirements.description: When an operator waits for a pipeline, the control plane MUST provide a durable wait operation that can resume without shell polling.

requirements.title: Operator commands filter evidence by pipeline
requirements.description: When an operator lists or shows evidence, the CLI MUST support pipeline-scoped lookup and return an actionable error for an unknown pipeline.

requirements.title: Desktop cells execute provider-owned journeys
requirements.description: When a desktop validation cell selects a provider-owned journey, scenario-to-desktop MUST execute that journey against the packaged application and retain its provider run identity in the desktop evidence.

requirements.title: Passing manifests name the journey kind
requirements.description: When a validation manifest passes, the manifest MUST name the selected journey kind and preserve the same selection in the journey sidecar.

requirements.title: Captures belong to their producing run
requirements.description: When a desktop journey persists capture references, the producer MUST reject a capture owned by another run and MUST retain the producing run identity with the evidence.

requirements.title: Isolation counts are observed
requirements.description: When a desktop runtime reports isolation, the evidence MUST use the observed adopted_session_count and MUST fail closed when the recorded count contradicts the recovery observation.

requirements.title: Every provider probe verifies app identity
requirements.description: When a provider or communication probe returns, the smoke test MUST verify the expected app_key and MUST report probe_app_mismatch or probe_app_unidentified when identity is not proven.

requirements.title: Manifest gates use independent dispositions
requirements.description: When a validation manifest is produced, each required gate MUST derive its disposition from its own signal and MUST NOT report a constant disposition or copy another gate.
